Comma Code.py.name: Comma-and-and list joiner
Comma Code.py.description: Builds a comma-separated string with and before the final item, printing intermediate values and the returned result. It compares item values with the final item rather than comparing positions.

birthdays.py.name: In-memory birthday lookup
birthdays.py.description: Prompts for a name, prints a known birthday or adds a supplied birthday to the process dictionary; blank input exits without persisting changes.

break.py.name: Break from a name loop
break.py.description: Repeats its name prompt until input exactly matches the embedded demonstration string, including its punctuation and trailing space.

bulletPointAdder.py.name: Clipboard bullet formatter
bulletPointAdder.py.description: Reads clipboard text through pyperclip, prefixes every newline-separated line with an asterisk and space, and writes the joined text back.

catnapping.py.name: Multiline string printing
catnapping.py.description: Prints a fixed demonstration letter using a triple-quoted string.

characterCount.py.name: Character frequency dictionary
characterCount.py.description: Counts every character in a fixed sentence using setdefault and prints the resulting dictionary.

characterPictureGrid.py.name: Transposed character picture
characterPictureGrid.py.description: Iterates across each column of the embedded grid and prints one transposed row per output line.

collatz.py.name: Collatz sequence practice
collatz.py.description: Converts one terminal input to an integer and repeatedly applies the even/odd Collatz rule until one; catches conversion ValueError but does not reprompt or validate positivity.

firstProgram.py.name: Name and age greeting
firstProgram.py.description: Reads a name and age, prints name length and the integer age plus one; invalid age input is not caught.

fiveTimes.py.name: Sum through one hundred
fiveTimes.py.description: Accumulates the integers produced by range(101) and prints the total; the filename is not its actual behavior.

guess.py.name: Six-attempt number guessing
guess.py.description: Chooses an integer from one through twenty, gives high/low feedback for up to six guesses and reports success or reveals the chosen number.

inventory.py.name: Inventory dictionary update
inventory.py.description: Adds repeated loot entries to an existing inventory dictionary, then prints each item count and the total quantity.

magic8Ball2.py.name: Random list-based fortune
magic8Ball2.py.description: Chooses and prints one message by a random valid index into the embedded response list.

myPets.py.name: Pet-name membership check
myPets.py.description: Reads one name and prints whether it belongs to the embedded pet-name list.

picnicTable.py.name: Aligned picnic inventory
picnicTable.py.description: Prints a centered heading and padded key/count rows twice using two width configurations.

prettyCharacterCount.py.name: Pretty-printed character counts
prettyCharacterCount.py.description: Builds the same kind of frequency dictionary as characterCount.py and formats it with pprint.

pw.py.name: Insecure password clipboard exercise
pw.py.description: Looks up an account command-line argument in a hardcoded dictionary and copies its value with pyperclip. The optional add branch only updates process memory; the mapping derivative replaces three literal values, not behavior.

sameName3.py.name: Global and local scope demonstration
sameName3.py.description: Shows a function updating a global name while another function prints an independent local name; a third defined function is not called.

sameName4.py.name: Read-before-local-assignment example
sameName4.py.description: Calls a function that reads a name before its local assignment, illustrating an UnboundLocalError rather than successful global lookup.

swordfish.py.name: Nested identity and password loop
swordfish.py.description: Continues until the classroom identity matches, then checks a fixed demonstration password and breaks on success; this is not real authentication.

tablePrinter.py.name: Table printer with width helper
tablePrinter.py.description: Calculates maximum item lengths with a helper, then prints equal-length input lists as right-aligned columns.

tablePrinterSol.py.name: Inline table width solution
tablePrinterSol.py.description: Computes each column width with nested loops and prints the transposed demonstration table; assumes equal-length input lists.

ticTacToe.py.name: Nine-turn dictionary board
ticTacToe.py.description: Prints a board, accepts a board key, writes the current mark and alternates X/O for nine turns; no winner or occupied-cell checks are implemented.

validateInput.py.name: Age and password text validation
validateInput.py.description: Repeats input until age text is decimal, then until password text is alphanumeric; does not save a credential or authenticate anyone.
